name: 66 - Core - Chunk and Index Knowledge Document - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT $1::BIGINT document_id,$2::INTEGER chunk_size_chars,$3::INTEGER overlap_chars),
d AS (
  SELECT k.id document_id,k.clinic_id,k.title,k.source_type,k.specialty,k.topic,
         k.version_label,k.status,k.raw_text,r.chunk_size_chars,r.overlap_chars
  FROM clinic_knowledge_documents k JOIN r ON r.document_id=k.id
  WHERE k.source_type<>'qa' AND k.raw_text IS NOT NULL
    AND LENGTH(TRIM(k.raw_text))>=20 AND k.status IN ('draft','processing','failed','review')
  LIMIT 1
),
job AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_knowledge_ingestion_jobs(document_id,status,chunk_size_chars,overlap_chars,started_at,updated_at)
  SELECT document_id,'processing',chunk_size_chars,overlap_chars,NOW(),NOW() FROM d
  ON CONFLICT(document_id) DO UPDATE SET status='processing',
    chunk_size_chars=EXCLUDED.chunk_size_chars,overlap_chars=EXCLUDED.overlap_chars,
    chunks_created=0,error_message=NULL,started_at=NOW(),completed_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW()
  RETURNING *
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE clinic_knowledge_documents k SET status='processing',updated_at=NOW()
  FROM d WHERE k.id=d.document_id RETURNING k.id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d) success,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM d) THEN 'knowledge_document_loaded' ELSE 'knowledge_document_not_processible' END result,
       (SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(d) FROM d) document_context
FROM r;

WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS document_id,
        $2::INTEGER AS chunk_index,
        NULLIF($3::INTEGER, 0) AS page_start,
        NULLIF($4::INTEGER, 0) AS page_end,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS section_title,
        $6::TEXT AS content,
        $7::TEXT AS content_hash,
        $8::INTEGER AS token_estimate,
        $9::JSONB AS keywords,
        $10::INTEGER AS total_chunks
),

upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO clinic_knowledge_chunks (
        document_id,
        chunk_index,
        page_start,
        page_end,
        section_title,
        content,
        content_hash,
        token_estimate,
        keywords,
        embedding_status,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        input.document_id,
        input.chunk_index,
        input.page_start,
        input.page_end,
        input.section_title,
        input.content,
        input.content_hash,
        input.token_estimate,
        input.keywords,
        'not_requested',
        NOW()
    FROM input_data input
    ON CONFLICT (
        document_id,
        chunk_index
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        page_start = EXCLUDED.page_start,
        page_end = EXCLUDED.page_end,
        section_title = EXCLUDED.section_title,
        content = EXCLUDED.content,
        content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
        token_estimate = EXCLUDED.token_estimate,
        keywords = EXCLUDED.keywords,
        embedding_status = CASE
            WHEN clinic_knowledge_chunks.content_hash <>
                 EXCLUDED.content_hash
                THEN 'pending'
            ELSE clinic_knowledge_chunks.embedding_status
        END,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING
        id,
        document_id,
        chunk_index
)

SELECT
    upserted.id,
    upserted.document_id,
    upserted.chunk_index,
    input.total_chunks
FROM upserted
CROSS JOIN input_data input;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS document_id,
        $2::INTEGER AS total_chunks,
        $3::INTEGER AS upserted_chunk_count
),

deleted_stale_chunks AS (
    DELETE FROM clinic_knowledge_chunks chunk
    USING request_data request
    WHERE chunk.document_id =
          request.document_id
      AND chunk.chunk_index >=
          request.total_chunks
    RETURNING chunk.id
),

chunk_count AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS chunks_created
    FROM clinic_knowledge_chunks chunk
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.document_id =
           chunk.document_id
),

updated_job AS (
    UPDATE clinic_knowledge_ingestion_jobs job
    SET
        status = 'completed',
        chunks_created = (
            SELECT chunks_created
            FROM chunk_count
        ),
        completed_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE job.document_id =
          request.document_id
    RETURNING job.*
),

updated_document AS (
    UPDATE clinic_knowledge_documents document
    SET
        status = 'review',
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE document.id =
          request.document_id
    RETURNING document.*
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'knowledge_document_chunked' AS result,
    request.document_id,

    (
        SELECT chunks_created
        FROM chunk_count
    ) AS chunks_created,

    request.upserted_chunk_count,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM deleted_stale_chunks
    ) AS stale_chunks_deleted,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_document
    ) AS document_status,

    'review_and_publish_document' AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## Chunk و Index

متن سند به بخش‌های هم‌پوشان تقسیم می‌شود.

نشانگر [[PAGE:12]] شماره صفحه Citation را حفظ می‌کند.

اصلاح V2:
- Finalize فقط یک‌بار بعد از Upsert همه Chunkها اجرا می‌شود.
- Chunkهای قدیمی خارج از محدوده سند جدید حذف می‌شوند.
- stale_chunks_deleted در خروجی برگردانده می‌شود.
